title: When Grown-Ups Throw Tantrums
coreMove: When a grown person sulks or explodes, the reaction is theirs to feel, not yours to fix. Stay kind, hold your limit, choose your move.

exampleSpecs.audience: Luz and readers facing adult childlike behavior
exampleSpecs.stakes: Compassion gets easier when immaturity is seen as limited capacity instead of absolute power.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Luz using adult childlike behavior in the source case without controlling another person.
